label: Bansei airfield (Army)

label: Miyakonojō airfield (Army)
note: "Miyakonojo Airfield", the diamond-shaped outline west of the city between Shiriedu, Kumiki and Shimo-minahara, with buildings on its east side and "Army Barracks" and a drill ground south of it; centre read off the sheet at 31°43.96'N 131°02.37'E (Tokyo datum, as printed), about ±700 m. About 300 nm from Haynsworth's noon fix. Read 28 Oct 2026
